threads.body: This only yields `resp` after the `for` loop finishes, which buffers the whole stream and returns only the last response (and raises if the stream is empty). The yield needs to happen inside the loop to preserve streaming behavior.

threads.body: This overwrites the process-wide `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_EMIT_EVENT` setting whenever the instrumentation is enabled in experimental mode. That ignores a user-provided `false` value and leaks the setting to other GenAI instrumentations until process exit/uninstrumentation cannot restore it.

threads.body:
This raw argument value is later passed to `gen_ai_json_dumps`; non-JSON-serializable tool arguments (for example model objects or sets) will raise from telemetry finalization after the user function has run. The previous wrapper coerced/fell back for these values, so this can break otherwise successful tool calls.
